description: This file contains source code for a set of C# classes that implement tests for SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL ADO.NET stream batching functionality using the Orleans framework. It defines test classes, including fixtures for setting up database connections, and configures test environment parameters.

classes.name: SqlServerAdoNetStreamsBatchingTests

classes.name: MySqlAdoNetStreamsBatchingTests
classes.description: Test class for MySQL ADO.NET stream batching, inherits from AdoNetStreamsBatchingTests.

classes.name: PostgreSqlAdoNetStreamsBatchingTests
classes.description: Test class for PostgreSQL ADO.NET stream batching, inherits from AdoNetStreamsBatchingTests.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamsBatchingTests
classes.description: Abstract base class providing common setup and configuration for ADO.NET stream batching tests, including lifecycle management.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamsBatchingTests.Fixture
classes.description: Fixture class responsible for initializing database connections, configuring test cluster, and setting up environment for streaming tests.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamsBatchingTests.Fixture.TestSiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures a silo builder with ADO.NET stream settings specific to the test invariant and connection string.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamsBatchingTests.Fixture.TestClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures an Orleans client builder with ADO.NET stream settings for the test environment.
